name: Lupus Flare Tracker
description:
Living with lupus means never knowing when the next flare will hit, explaining an invisible illness, and managing lifelong medication. Lunaire Lupus Tracker is a private, offline flare and symptom diary built for patients who are tired of cloud-based apps, ads, and accounts that harvest their health data. Every flare, joint ache, rash, fatigue episode, and missed dose you log stays on your phone, always.

WHAT YOU CAN TRACK
• Lupus flare severity and duration
• Joint pain location and intensity
• Malar (butterfly) rash, discoid rash, and skin changes
• Fatigue and energy levels
• Mouth and nose ulcers
• Hair loss
• Raynaud's episodes
• Brain fog and cognitive symptoms
• Fever and photosensitivity
• Medications — hydroxychloroquine, steroids, immunosuppressants, biologics
• Medication adherence and missed doses
• Blood test dates and appointment reminders
• Food, exercise, mood, sleep, and 30+ other symptoms
• Weight and body changes

PRIVACY-FIRST BY DESIGN
Most lupus apps need an account, run ads, or sync your health data to their servers. Ours does not.
✓ No accounts. No sign-up. Open the app and start logging.
✓ No cloud. Your data lives in a local database only you control.
✓ No ads. Ever.
✓ No tracking. No analytics.
✓ Full offline — works with no internet, anywhere.

UNDERSTAND YOUR FLARES
Lupus flares are notoriously unpredictable — but patterns exist. Lunaire keeps your symptoms, suspected triggers (sun exposure, stress, missed meds, poor sleep, infection, food), and medication adherence side by side, so you can read your own data over time. Deeper symptom-and-trigger correlation analysis is part of Premium.

PDF REPORTS FOR YOUR DOCTOR
A 15-minute appointment isn't long enough to describe six months of symptoms from memory. Generate a clean PDF report of your flare frequency, joint pain patterns, fatigue cycles, and medication adherence — ready to email, print, or share with your doctor, rheumatologist, or lupus specialist.

BUILT FOR LUPUS PATIENTS
Every category, symptom list, and chart was designed around what lupus patients actually track: flare triggers, malar rashes, joint flares, sun sensitivity, medication side effects, and the daily reality of living with SLE.

If you live with systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), discoid lupus, drug-induced lupus, overlap syndromes, or undifferentiated connective tissue disease, this tracker is built for you.

FREE FEATURES
• Unlimited flare, pain, and symptom logging
• Calendar view of your flares
• Food, exercise, supplement, and medication diary
• Trends and charts
• 7 day trend analysis
• Weight tracking
• Full history

PREMIUM FEATURES
• Unlimited trend analysis
• Unlimited PDF reports
• CSV data export
• Complete backup & restore (local JSON file)

Lupus is unpredictable. Track yours — privately.

Premium is available as an affordable monthly / yearly subscription or a lifetime one-time purchase.

Built by Lunaire Labs. Privacy-first symptom trackers for Cycle, Perimenopause/Menopause, PMDD, Endometriosis, Thyroid, IBS, Fibromyalgia, POTS and Lupus.

Available in: English, Deutsch, Nederlands, Français, Español, Italiano, Português, Svenska, Norsk, Dansk, Suomi, Polski, Türkçe, 日本語, 한국어, 繁體中文.

Important: Lunaire Lupus Tracker is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any condition. It is a personal symptom diary. name: Doctor On Demand
description:
Doctor On Demand by Included Health offers 24/7 access to board-certified doctors, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists via secure video visits from your phone, tablet, or computer. Fast Access to Online Doctors – See a board-certified, US-based provider with telehealth appointments anytime, day or night.

Therapy & Psychiatry – Book virtual visits for mental health concerns like stress, anxiety, depression, PTSD, trauma, and more.

Online Urgent Care, Treatment, Prescriptions – For colds, flu, allergies, skin conditions, UTIs, headaches, and more, our providers can send prescriptions to nearby pharmacies if medically appropriate.

Doctor’s Notes – Need a doctor’s note for work or school? We’ve got you covered. See an urgent care provider for help.

Insurance or Self-Pay – We work with major health plans and many employers to reduce the costs of visits for eligible members. If not covered, we offer affordable visit costs to all patients with no surprise bills.

How It Works

 2. Choose to see the first available provider, or schedule a visit.
 3. Get personalized care, prescriptions, and treatment plans in an online visit.

✔️ Cold, Flu & Sinus Infections

Frequently Asked Questions
🕒 When are doctors available?
Our virtual providers are available 24/7, 365 days a year, including weekends and holidays. Mental health appointments are often available within days—much faster than traditional providers who can take weeks

💲 How much does a visit cost?
You’ll always see your exact visit cost upfront. We accept most insurance plans and partner with top employers and health plans to lower your costs. No insurance? Our telehealth visit costs are affordable.

👩‍⚕️ Who are the doctors?
Our US-based, board-certified doctors, licensed psychiatrists, and therapists have an average of 15 years of experience and come from diverse specialties to ensure you receive expert care.

🤳How does it work?
Join a telehealth visit to connect face to face with a provider from your phone, tablet, or computer in as little as ten minutes. Like an in-person visit, your provider will discuss with you how you’re feeling, your healthcare history, and propose a recommended treatment plan. Labs, screenings, and prescriptions will be sent to nearby facilities.

⚕️What can you treat?
Our urgent care doctors can treat hundreds of issues, including cold and flu, urinary tract infections, allergies, headache, sprains, and skin conditions. They can also order labs and screenings to help with preventative care and help manage chronic care conditions. Our extensive team of therapists and psychiatrists are able to treat anxiety, stress, depression, PTSD, trauma and loss relationships, and more.

Your Privacy is Our Priority
We adhere to strict HIPAA guidelines to protect your health data and personal information.

SHIFT WORK MYTHS VS. CIRCADIAN SCIENCE

Shift workers face a serious biological challenge: misalignment between their internal circadian rhythms and their work schedules. This circadian disruption leads to insomnia, excessive sleepiness, poor performance, and increased long-term health risks.

Popular advice — like drinking more coffee, using supplements, or simply “getting more rest” — misses the mark. These approaches don’t address the root cause: your circadian misalignment.

It’s time to replace the myths with real science.

Generic tips won’t solve circadian disruption. Only evidence-based interventions that "reset" your circadian rhythms and manage circadian timing can effectively reduce the negative effects of shift work.

THE REAL SCIENCE OF SHIFT WORK

// In your brain, a circadian clock regulates the rhythm of your day.
// Shift work causes your sleep and other behaviors to occur at biologically inappropriate times, resulting in fatigue, poor sleep, and long-term health risks.
// Light is the most powerful cue for resetting your circadian clock. The correct timing of light exposure and light avoidance is the foundation of any circadian intervention to improve alertness and sleep quality. If your timing is off, it can make things worse.

WHY SHIFT WORKERS LOVE TIMESHIFTER

// Based on the latest sleep and circadian science
// Optimizes your sleep, alertness, and performance

name: SleepEngine
description:
Scientific sound technology for the SmartPillow by Cambridge Sleep Sciences.



Welcome to SleepEngine™ – the App which powers the Cambridge Sleep Sciences SmartPillow and enables you to enjoy better sleep using scientifically developed sound technology. Whether you suffer from insomnia, work alternative shift patterns, wake frequently during the night or are looking to optimise sleep for better physical and mental performance, SleepEngine™ technology can help improve your sleep and enhance your health and wellbeing.



WHAT IS SLEEPENGINE™ TECHNOLOGY?
This unique technology uses a neuroscientific approach to create sound waves which match the waves created by the adult brain during healthy sleep cycles. When any of the SleepEngine™ Sleep Programs are played, the sound waves (we call them Sleepsounds) guide your brain through the correct sequence of healthy sleep cycles so you can fall asleep quicker, stay asleep for longer and improve the overall quality of your sleep.
Poor sleep habits, lifestyle factors and other circumstances can disrupt healthy sleep patterns. Over time, your brain can forget the correct sequence of patterns and this is where difficulty falling and staying asleep can take hold. SleepEngine™ has been developed to retrain your brain to restore natural sleep patterns. And this all happens while you sleep!



HOW IT WORKS
The high quality pillow contains a small unit with two speakers inside. The SleepEngine™ App connects the unit to your smart device using Bluetooth. The App controls the unit and enables you to easily play your chosen Sleep Program, optional Soundscape and set your alarm, if required.
When playing the Sleepsounds, you will hear low frequency tones which guide you into sleep and encourage your brain to follow the sequence of healthy sleep cycles. When your chosen Sleep Program ends, you will wake up at the right point in the sleep cycle, refreshed and energised from improved sleep quality.
Regular and repeated use of SleepEngine™ will help to retrain your brain to produce the right sequence of sleep cycles and restore natural healthy sleep patterns.



PROVEN TECHNOLOGY
In two independent trials of the SleepEngine™ technology, featured in the SleepHub® sleep aid, 92%+ of users saw a positive improvement in their sleep and experienced on average per night, up to 2.5 hours more time per sleep per night and up to 1.5 less waking times.
SleepEngine™ technology, used in the SleepHub® sleep aid, has also received many positive reviews from the media and consumers around the world.



CHOICE OF SLEEP PROGRAMS & SOUND FEATURES
The SleepEngine™ App controls all the sound technology features of the SmartPillow. Once the App has been connected to the SmartPillow, you can personalise your sleep experience by choosing your preferred sleep settings. By experimenting with different settings, you can discover which ones help you to best fall asleep and stay asleep throughout the night.
There are 4 Sleep Programs to choose from:
Deep Sleep: a recommended 8-hour program which includes an 18 minute wake-up cycle and alarm
Easy Sleep: choose 2 to 8 hours of sleep when you don’t have enough time for the Deep Sleep program
Fall Asleep: a 2 hour program which guides you into deep sleep; ideal for those who struggle to get to sleep
Power Nap: provides an energising nap for 30, 45 or 60 minutes
You can further customise your sleep experience by playing relaxing and calming Soundscapes alongside the Sleepsounds. Choose from Ocean, Rain, Stream, Wind, Train and White, Pink and Brown Noise.
You can also set your preferred alarm sound from a selection of smooth and energetic options which enable you to wake up in the mood that suits you most.
Sound controls enable you to adjust your volume and balance levels, to ensure you achieve the optimal sleep experience using the SleepEngine™ technology.

name: Quiet Sleep: Thought Dump
description:
Quiet Sleep is a calm bedtime ritual for people whose thoughts get loud at night. Use a private thought dump, guided breathing, cognitive shuffle, and calm sleep sounds to put the day down before sleep.

When you lie down, your mind can keep replaying plans, unfinished tasks, worries, conversations, and tomorrow's to-dos. Quiet Sleep gives those thoughts a place outside your head so your evening can feel simpler and more contained.

No ads. No account required. No social feed. No streak pressure. Quiet Sleep is designed for a short nightly routine, then putting the phone away.

What you can do in Quiet Sleep:

• Dump thoughts by text or voice
Write or speak whatever is still active in your mind. It does not need to be neat, complete, or well written. Fragments, lists, and unfinished thoughts are welcome.

• Use a short session timer
Choose a simple timed session so your bedtime routine stays contained. The goal is to place thoughts outside your head, not stay in the app longer than needed.

• Practice guided breathing
Choose from 4-7-8 breathing, box breathing, equal breathing, long exhale, coherent breathing, and the physiological sigh. Follow the calm circle, set your cycle count, and adjust cues for tonight.

• Try cognitive shuffle
Let the app show or speak simple random words so your mind can move through gentle, unrelated images instead of looping on the same thoughts.

• Play sleep sounds with a timer
Rain, nighttime atmospheres, white noise, purring, and other relaxing sounds help shape a softer bedtime environment. Set the timer and volume, then let the sound end on its own.

• Track evenings in a calendar
See entries, mood, sleep rating, breathing sessions, and shuffle sessions by day. Notice patterns without scores, streaks, or judgment.

• Get gentle reflection on entries
Quiet Sleep can highlight themes and the overall tone of your thoughts so you can look at them with more distance. It is reflection, not therapy or diagnosis.

• Keep private data on your device
Entries, settings, and history are stored locally on your device. You can protect sensitive text with a PIN, export your data, and control what stays in the app.

Quiet Sleep may be helpful if you:

• replay thoughts at bedtime;
• want a private bedtime journal;
• need a simple nighttime relaxation routine;
• prefer a minimal sleep app with no ads;
• use journaling, guided breathing, cognitive shuffle, or sleep sounds;
• want one place for evening reflection;
• care about privacy and local storage.

Quiet Sleep is not a medical app, does not diagnose conditions, and does not replace professional care. If sleep, anxiety, or stress is seriously affecting your life, please contact a doctor or qualified professional.

Put the day down. Give your thoughts a place. Let the night get quieter.

So what makes Nomadago useful?

PERSONAL TRAVEL COMMUNITY

Add your friends and never lose touch with the people you meet traveling. Create your network of traveling friends and easily plan when you’ll see eachother next.

TRAVEL JOURNAL

Track all the places you’ve been and the trips you’ve been on. Nomadago will display a personal map of all the countries you’ve visited and give you a percentage of the world that you have seen.

FIND FRIENDS

Connect with other Nomadago users by posting your plans to the community, outside of your friend network. Or checking out other users' plans to see if you’ll be in the same area.

LOCATION SHARING

Share your current location and see where all your friends are currently using the world map

COUNTRY SEARCH

Search for plans in a specific country to see all your friends who are currently in that country or will be on future dates.

CALENDAR CREATION

You are able to build out your travel calendar for as far in advance as you would like. This calendar can be seen by all of your friends so they know what you're up to. You can also check out their calendar.

PLAN EDITOR

Make plans to add to your calendar, set the location of where you are going, invite your friends to the plan, and discuss the trip in the comments.

PLAN FEED

Check out the feed to see all new plans being posted by your friends. Comment on any plans if you are interested in joining.


FUTURE LOCATIONS

Change the dates on the map to see where all of your friends plan to be on upcoming dates. This will give you ideas on your next location to go to and when to go.

CROSSING PATHS ALERTS

The app notifies you if you’re in the same city as a friend or if both you and a friend create a future plan to be in the same city during the same time.

Stop refreshing ImmiAccount. Start understanding your skilled visa journey.

★ SEE THE OFFICIAL EOI QUEUE
Explore SkillSelect EOI pool data for the 189, 190 and 491 visa, sourced from the Department of Home Affairs (https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/visas/working-in-australia/skillselect). See how many EOIs sit at each points band, your queue position — how many candidates are ahead of you — which states are in demand, and who was recently invited at your points. Try what-if mode: switch subclass and your score updates with the 190 or 491 nomination bonus automatically.

★ CALCULATE YOUR POINTS
A full GSM points test calculator for the skilled visa. Score age, English, skilled employment, education and partner points, plus the state-nomination bonus (+5 for the 190 visa, +15 for the 491 visa). Instantly see how your score compares with the real EOI pool.

★ A DASHBOARD THAT KNOWS YOUR STAGE
Before your invitation, the dashboard shows your invite outlook from official INVITED data. Once invited, it counts down your 60-day lodgement deadline. After lodgement, it shows a grant outlook built from recent community grants — and when your visa is granted, it celebrates with a full journey summary.

★ TRACK YOUR VISA TIMELINE
Log every milestone of your skilled visa application — skills assessment, EOI, state nomination, visa lodgement, medicals, police checks and grant. Your timeline shows the days elapsed at each stage, and push notifications keep you on track through the whole 189, 190 or 491 process.

★ COMPARE WITH THE COMMUNITY
Browse real visa timelines and a live feed of recent grants shared by skilled migration applicants. Filter by subclass (189, 190, 491), occupation, nominating state and lodgement year to find cases just like yours — and see how long they actually waited.

★ PREDICT YOUR PROCESSING TIME
Our analytics are built on real community data, not guesswork. See the average grant processing time for your occupation and visa subclass, and learn where you sit in the 50th, 75th or 90th percentile.

★ PRIVACY FIRST
Share your visa timeline anonymously or with full detail — it's your choice. Nothing is shared publicly without your consent, and your data always stays yours.

★ OFFICIAL GOVERNMENT SOURCES
All government information shown in this app comes from official Australian Government sources:
• SkillSelect & EOI data — Department of Home Affairs: https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/visas/working-in-australia/skillselect
• Skilled migration points test: https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/help-support/tools/points-calculator
• Visa subclasses 189, 190 and 491: https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/visas/getting-a-visa/visa-listing
• Visa processing times: https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/visas/getting-a-visa/visa-processing-times
For official advice about your visa application, always refer to the Department of Home Affairs. This app does not provide migration advice and does not represent a government entity.

Whether you're an accountant watching the 189 EOI queue, a nurse waiting on a 190 state nomination, or an engineer counting the days since 491 lodgement, Skilled Visa Tracker helps you stay informed and connected during the long skilled migration wait.

Track your points, track your timeline, and track your path to Australian PR — all in one skilled visa tracker. Download now and join the community.

name: Plant Care Tracker - Ploi
description:
Ploi is a plant care tracker for people who want to remember what they did and when. Log every watering, build a care history for each plant, and let Ploi learn your routine instead of following a generic schedule.

Watering reminders that learn

No app can tell you exactly how often to water your plants: it depends on light, humidity, pot size and season. So Ploi learns instead of guessing. Log a watering, and Ploi picks up your real rhythm and moves the next reminder to match. The more you log, the better the reminders fit.

A journal for every plant

Every watering, feeding, repotting and note goes into that plant's own timeline, and you can scroll back through it any time. Weeks later you can see exactly when you last fertilized, how long the plant went without water, or the day a new leaf appeared. It is a care log and a plant diary in one.

Growth photos over time

Add a photo to any log entry and watch your plant's story come together. A fiddle leaf fig, a monstera, a snake plant or a peace lily all look different six months on, and Ploi keeps every photo so you can see the change for yourself.

Care guides by species

Ploi includes care guides for individual plant species, covering watering, light, soil and humidity. Look up what your plant needs instead of relying on a generic houseplant article.

Plant identification

Not sure what you have? Take a photo and Ploi identifies the species, then starts a care log for it. Most people start with identification — but what Ploi is really for is everything you record afterwards.

Wishlist and rooms

Keep a wishlist of plants you want, and group the ones you own by room or windowsill, so you can water everything in one trip around the house.

Built for people who like to keep records

When did I last water this? How has it changed? Which routine actually worked? Ploi answers all three.

Subscribe for unlimited plants and advanced care features.

Terms of Use: https://ploi.me/terms

name: PlantNet Plant Identification
description:
Pl@ntNet is an application that allows you to identify plants simply by photographing them with your smartphone. Very useful when you don't have a botanist on hand! Pl@ntNet is also a great citizen science project: all the plants you photograph are collected and analysed by scientists around the world to better understand the evolution of plant biodiversity and to better preserve it.

Pl@ntNet allows you to identify and better understand all kinds of plants living in nature: flowering plants, trees, grasses, conifers, ferns, vines, wild salads or cacti. Pl@ntNet can also identify a large number of cultivated plants (in parks and gardens) but this is not its primary purpose. We especially need Pl@ntNet’s users to inventory the wild plants, those that you can observe in nature of course but also those that grow on the sidewalks of our cities or in the middle of your vegetable garden!

The more visual information you give to Pl@ntNet about the plant you are observing, the more accurate the identification will be. There are indeed many plants that look alike from afar and it is sometimes small details that distinguish two species of the same genus. Flowers, fruits and leaves are the most characteristic organs of a species and it is them that should be photographed first. But any other detail can be useful, such as thorns, buds or hair on the stem. A photograph of the whole plant (or the tree if it is one!) is also very useful information, but it is often not sufficient to allow a reliable identification.

At present Pl@ntNet makes it possible to recognize about 20,000 species. We are still a long way from the 360,000 species living on earth, but Pl@ntNet is getting richer every day thanks to the contributions of the most experienced users among you. Don't be afraid to contribute yourself! Your observation will be reviewed by the community and may one day join the photo gallery illustrating the species in the application.

The new version of Pl@ntNet released in January 2019 includes many improvements and new features:
- The ability to filter recognized species by genus or family.
- The differentiated data revision that gives more weight to users who have demonstrated the most skills (in particular the number of species observed, validated by the community).
- The re-identification of shared observations, whether yours or those of other users of the application.
- The multi-flora identification that allows you to search for the photographed plant in all the flora of the application and not only in the one you have selected. Very useful when you are not sure what flora to look for.
- The selection of your favorite floras to access them more quickly.
- The navigation at different taxonomic levels in image galleries.
- The mapping of your observations.
- Links to many factsheets.

The web version of the application is also available at the following address: https://identify.plantnet.org/

Create your dream yard with easy-to-use tools, helpful grow and care tips, and the largest outdoor plant library available in any app. The ultimate landscape planner and garden tracker for all your outdoor spaces.

The only app with:

Try the new way to discover what's living around you, re-imagine the outdoor space of your dreams, and connect with friends and neighbors.

Why use Sow?
• Landscape Design with Real Plants
Visualize before you plant! Our exclusive generator taps a library of 10,000+ real cultivars and nativars to create stunning concepts in seconds—no generic plants here! Get botanically correct ideas tailored to your specific hardiness zone. No CAD skills required.

• Instant Plant Identifier
Snap a pic and the app instantly identifies the plant. Add it to your plant library, map its location, and get care tips.

• Smart Watering & Frost Calendar
Save money and water. Get rainfall tracking, drought alerts, and irrigation forecasts so you only water when Mother Nature won’t.

• Drag-and-Drop Yard Mapper
Map vegetable beds or entire properties on a true-scale canvas. Use satellite & solar overlays to ensure every flower and tree is in the perfect spot for the sun. Create professional site plans and layout drawings with one tap. Upscale it all to 4k for precision mapping.

• The Plant Marketplace
Compare live prices and check inventory from top online nurseries. Save up to 80% vs. retail mark-ups on everything from native perennials to privacy trees.

• Community & Advice
Join the neighborhood network growing right outside your door. Share plants, ask questions, and trade tips—no negativity, just nature.

• Web access included at usesow.com
Seamlessly jump from app to web without losing your designs or data. Everything is saved to the cloud and available instantly on both platforms.

• Built for every green thumb
From balcony pots to acre-wide projects, Sow’s 10,000+ cultivar database and adaptive design tools scale with your ambition—pollinator gardens, xeriscapes, veggie beds, you name it.

Download Sow and start connecting in a new way with the natural world outside your window!

We really hope you enjoy using Sow. We are continuously striving to make the experience better and better. Please do not hesitate to contact us with any feedback and/or questions, tap “Give Feedback” in-app or email us at hello@usesow.com.

• Keep your care streak alive

WHO IS POTKEEP FOR?
• Beginners who want simple guidance and friendly reminders

• Anyone who loves watching something grow

Whether you have one succulent on your desk or a jungle on your balcony, Potkeep helps you build a routine that keeps every plant happy — and makes the journey a joy to look back on.

name: Home Inventory & Food: InvenDo
description:
This app is the ultimate tool for keeping all your things in order and streamlining your shopping processes. Organize things in your flat, home, fridge, pantry, garage, basement, or anywhere else.
With the ability to create storage places and categorize items within them, you'll always know where everything is and be able to find it quickly and easily. - Scan and record barcodes to speed things up;
- Set Minimum quantity values to get alerts when your stock is low;
- Record expiration dates and get notified when a product will expire soon;
- Add photos to keep a visual representation of an item;

This app can be used for a wide range of things, including:

Food products:
- Keep track of the food supplies in your fridge, pantry, and basement, and never miss an expiry date again. Get notified about low stock levels and expiring items, and replenish in time.
Clothes:
- Know what you own, so you don't end up buying duplicates or forgetting about items you already have.
Homeware:
- Keep your home organized and never misplace anything again. Know exactly where to find your tools, appliances, and other items.
Hobby collections:
- Organize your collection into categories (folders), make photos of the items, and create a convenient catalog.
Cosmetics:
- Create a list of your cosmetic products to know what you have and what you need, and never use expired products again.
Medicines:
- Keep track of your medicines and make sure you always have enough of the ones you need with a proper shelf life.

One of the most useful features of the app is the ability to add photos or images of the items in your inventory. This makes it even easier to identify and locate the items you're looking for, and helps you keep track of what you have in a more visual and intuitive way.

The app also has the ability to scan and record barcodes. If you've added a barcode to an item, you can later scan it to add or remove the item from your inventory. This makes it easy and convenient to keep track of what you have

Another key feature is the ability to share data with other people and use the app together with your family. Whether you're living with roommates, a partner, or children, this app makes it easy to collaborate and keep everyone on the same page.

Finally, the app also allows you to export your lists to Excel, giving you even more flexibility and control over your inventory and shopping processes. Whether you want to keep a backup of your data or use it in other apps and software, the option to export to Excel is a powerful and convenient feature.

We're always glad to hear your suggestions and are here to help if you need support. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to contact us at chester.help.si+homelist@gmail.com.

So why wait? Download the app today and start taking control of your inventory and shopping processes! Whether you're tracking food supplies, clothes, homeware, tools, hobby collections, cosmetics, medicines, or anything else, this app has you covered.

name: Partender – Fast Bar Inventory
description:
As featured on Paramount Network's "Bar Rescue" Partender is a patented, subscription-based business tool with a proprietary design that empowers you to:
- Do full, physical bar inventory in just 15 minutes and with up to 99.2% accuracy
- Split up the work across as many users as you'd like on iOS, Android, and even the web
- Generate editable "Smart Orders" based on what you actually went through
- Place, track, and receive those orders online
- Get alerted when prices change
- Get your Usage (for Variance)
- Get your Actual Cost of Goods Sold (COGS for Bev Cost %)
- See what’s trending in your venue such as Top Movers and Dead Stock

And besides saving time and labor, our customers:
1) Reduce Inventory Value On-Hand by 20-40%
2) Reduce Beverage Cost by 6-8%
3) Reduce Cost of Goods Fluctuation by 10%

...all in just 90 days of weekly use after setup.

Here’s what some of them had to say:

"Inventory takes less than 15 minutes now. It used to take 2 hours with 3 people counting, for a total of 6 labor hours."
- Grant S. at Boston Pizza

“It takes us just 15 minutes to do inventory, which we do at least twice a week. We stopped running out of things, and thanks to Partender, we managed to get beverage costs down to 20% in a matter of months."
- Mike W. at Marriott

How? Why?

Because when you count your inventory as accurately and as frequently as you count the cash in your register, less disappears. And the average shrinkage in our industry is 23% because no one's counting how much is there.

So when your inventory is 10-50x more valuable than your cash register, it makes sense to count it as carefully as the till, but that's been impossible until Partender.

So throw out your paper-and-pen and homegrown spreadsheets. Do inventory in minutes - not hours. See what's selling the best/worst, what's dead stock (and needs to get phased out via happy hour promotions), and what's about to run out and get 86'd (so you never miss a sale).

Stop manually typing your inventory into Excel or a glorified web-based spreadsheet. Let Partender streamline all of your inventory, ordering, and accounting operations in just 15 minutes a week.

With Partender, you can also:
- Monitor actual depletions
- See real-time customer insights for your actual customers on a per-product or per-category basis
- Instantly receive your Value On-Hand (like a "Balance Sheet") in wholesale and retail dollars after every inventory
- Optimize your par levels (based on online graphs) to buy more of what's selling the best and less of what's selling the worst
- Clearly understand why your cost of goods is going up (due to Price Change Alerts or due to shrinkage* via our Usage / Variance Report online

*Shrinkage is the loss of inventory due to over-pouring, theft, breakage, spillage, not tracking comps, etc. And there's an average 23% shrinkage in the industry which causes 60-80% of bars and restaurants to fail within 3 years. Or let significant amounts of revenue just walk out the door.

HOW DOES PARTENDER WORK?
Build a virtual "blueprint" of your venue after organizing your bar to split up the work of inventory across Main Bar, Back Bar, Stock Room, etc. Instead of manually writing down your inventory using an arbitrary 10-point scale, cumbersome scales, or expensive hardware, simply tap where the liquor level is on the real image of the bottle and swipe to the next bottle on your shelf. That's it! Our proprietary algorithms are up to 99.2% accurate so you know down to the drop & dollar-value how much each bottle is worth in Retail & Wholesale Dollars ($).

INVENTORY ANYTHING:
In addition to liquor, you can inventory beer, wine, smallwares, kegs, and FOOD! Our database is huge. If there's something on your shelf that's not in our database: take a picture of it, and our proprietary algorithms will do the rest.

ANALYTICS IN THE CLOUD:
Just log into your web dashboard to see COGS, beautiful graphs & trends of what customers are drinking in real-time.

Log your play sessions and keep track of what, when and where you played. You can also log who played and who won and with what score. Never forget.

name: Clue: Official Hasbro Game
description:
Join fellow detectives all over the world in the official digital board game version of Clue! Gather crucial evidence, interrogate suspects and solve the original murder mystery.

Follow Miss Scarlett, Colonel Mustard, Professor Plum, Chef White, Solicitor Peacock and Mayor Green through the iconic Tudor Mansion, unlocking their motives and alibis as you go.

Enjoy Clue the way you remember it in Classic Mode, or jump in for a quick game with Clue Cards mode. Alternatively, if you want to really test your sleuthing skills, try a new investigation format available exclusively to Clue – Ultimate Detective.

In Ultimate Detective Mode, everyone answers suggestions at the same time…but secretly!

Face your suspects in a direct interrogation as you rely on your skills of deduction to get to the truth. Experience the mystery, solve the murder and become a top-tier detective!

HOW TO PLAY CLUE:

1. Three cards are dealt face-down and set aside – this is the solution to the crime!
2. Everyone is dealt three Clue Cards. These are automatically crossed off your clue sheet, as they can’t be part of the solution.
3. Roll the dice and move around the board.
4. When you enter a room, you can make a suggestion – select who you think the murderer is, what weapon they used and where the crime happened.
5. Other players will then aim to disprove your suggestion; if one of your suggestions matches a card in their hand, they show you that card to disprove it.
6. Use your clue sheet to keep track of which characters, weapons and rooms have been disproven.
7. Think you’ve figured it out? It’s time to make an accusation! Be careful though – if you’re right, you win, but if you are wrong, you’re out!

FEATURES

- THE CLASSIC TUDOR MANSION – Play the beloved original board game, now rendered in stunning 3D animation and entirely ad-free!
- A BRAND-NEW GAME MODE – Exclusive to the digital version of Clue, Ultimate Detective Mode lets you interrogate multiple characters at once.
- MULTIPLE MODES – Compete against advanced AI opponents that adjust to your skill level for the ideal game, or challenge detectives worldwide.
- ADDITIONAL ORIGINAL CONTENT – What happened after the shocking events of Tudor Mansion? Find out in a series of original new crime scenes designed specifically for the digital version of Cluedo! New characters emerge, bringing with them new clues, motives and case files to consider as you travel around the world in search of the truth.

Sharpen your mind with the iconic murder-mystery board game, now available on mobile!

Score Counter replaces pen, paper, and calculator. Focus on the game, not the math!

name: Out of the Loop
description:
Out of the Loop is a fun and easy to learn new party game for 3-9 players. Play at a party, waiting in line or on your next road trip!

Answer silly questions about the secret word to figure out who in the group doesn’t have a clue about what everyone else is talking about.

------ WHAT IS IT?

Out of the Loop is a mobile party game by the creators of Triple Agent! All you need to play is a single Android device and a few friends. Each round takes around 5-10 minutes to play and at the end of the night whoever has the most points wins!

----- FEATURES

- No setup! Just pick up and play.
- Easy to learn! Learn the game as you go, the perfect filler game.
- Short rounds! Play a quick game or several rounds.
- Hundreds of secret words and questions.
- Diverse categories for varied play.

----- GAMEPLAY

After choosing a category for the round, each player either gets to know a secret word in the category or that they are Out of the Loop. Each player then proceeds to answer a single question about the word before voting for who they think is Out of the Loop. Did someone have a suspicious answer? Did they not laugh at the thought of doughnut filled doughnuts? Vote for them!
On the flip side, the Out person has to figure out the secret word. If they do, all is for nought, so make sure you’re not too obvious!

Hilarious questions and deep suspense make Out of the Loop a fantastic game for your next party!

TRENDING BRANDS
See which brands and categories are moving right now, so you source ahead of demand.

WHO USES THRIFT SNAP
• Thrift store and charity shop regulars
• Clothing resellers and side hustlers
• Vintage and denim collectors

• Anyone turning a closet clear-out into cash

name: Reseller Listings: Shelvio
description:
Your bottleneck isn't sourcing. It's listing.

Shelvio is the batch listing station for resellers. Shoot the pile in one batch, voice in the details, and Shelvio drafts every listing while you keep shooting. Titles, descriptions, categories, condition, keywords, and pricing notes, ready for eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, Etsy, Facebook Marketplace, and more.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Capture. Start a batch for a thrift haul, closet cleanout, estate pile, or weekly listing session. Photograph each item and add a quick voice note with measurements, flaws, tags, anything a buyer needs to know.

2. Draft. Shelvio's AI turns your photos and voice notes into complete draft listings in the background. By the time you finish the pile, your first drafts are already waiting.

3. Review. You stay the editor. Every listing is a draft until you say otherwise.

4. List. Connect your eBay account and publish straight from Shelvio, with eBay's own category and item specifics filled in for you. Everywhere else, Review & Copy walks you through each field, fast, with no risky automation that could get your accounts flagged.

KNOW YOUR NUMBERS

- Log what you paid, record the sale, and see your real profit per item after fees.
- Bin and shelf locations mean a sale never turns into a hunt. Mark an item sold and see exactly where it's stored.
- SKUs, listing links, and search across everything you stock.
- Sales, sourcing, and monthly reports show what's really making you money.
- Export your inventory to CSV for spreadsheets or taxes.
- Just say it while you shoot: "paid three bucks at Goodwill, going in bin fourteen" fills your cost, source, and location automatically.

BUILT FOR HOW RESELLERS ACTUALLY WORK

- Capture offline in basements and flea markets; drafts generate when you're back online.
- Voice notes catch what photos can't: feel, flaws, measurements, provenance.
- Strong with vintage and collectibles: era, pattern, color name, and authentication markers make it into the listing.
- Scan a barcode while you shoot and Shelvio pulls catalog details for books, games, and packaged goods.
- See current eBay asking prices before you set yours.
- Batches stay organized so a 30-item haul doesn't become a death pile.
- Descriptions read like you wrote them: matter-of-fact and grounded in your photos and voice notes. No invented backstories, no guessed measurements.
- Your whole workspace is on the web too: review and manage from any browser at app.shelvio.ai.
- Sold somewhere? Shelvio warns you where it's still live so you never double-sell.

WHAT SHELVIO IS NOT

Outside eBay, Shelvio doesn't auto-publish and doesn't log into your marketplace accounts. It creates drafts; you review and post them yourself. eBay publishing only happens when you connect your account and tap publish.

YOUR DATA

Photos and voice notes are used only to generate your listings, never to train AI models. Voice notes stay available for replay inside the app, and deleting a listing or your account removes its photos and recordings from our servers. You can delete listings or your whole account anytime.

PRICING

Start with 5 free listings. No credit card, no timed trial. Your free listings never expire.

Going unlimited is optional. Every auto-renewable plan includes unlimited listings for normal individual reselling, subject to fair use and a high monthly safety ceiling: no credit meters or per-item fees.

Payment is charged to your Google Play account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel in Google Play > Subscriptions.

Terms of Service: https://shelvio.ai/terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy: https://shelvio.ai/privacy-policy/

Questions? support@shelvio.ai

Clear the pile. Keep your weekend.

COLLX SPORTS AND TCG SCANNER

BUY AND SELL

Cards bought through the CollX Marketplace are also covered by the CollX Protect policy, where payments are only released when the cards arrive at the Buyer, giving peace of mind to both parties in a deal.

GET HISTORICAL PRICING
CollX uses millions of historical auction prices to calculate a card’s average value. As you add cards to your collection, you’ll see your overall portfolio value grow. Set conditions or grades on your cards and get more accurate prices. As your cards rise or fall in value, CollX helps you track both individual card values and your overall portfolio value. No more wondering what your Pokémon card value is!

BUILD YOUR CARD COLLECTION
Create and keep track of your card values. View your collection as a grid, list, or as sets. You can also filter and sort your cards by a variety of criteria — value, date added, year, team, etc. With CollX Pro, you can export your collection as a CSV. You can also view your sets, see how close you are to completion, and generate printable checklists to help track down cards you're missing from a set.

SEARCH CARDS

name: Mealime Meal Plans & Recipes
description:
Mealime is a simple way for busy singles, couples, and families to plan their meals and eat healthier. Our meal plans & recipes are highly customizable so you can easily personalize a plan that works with your unique tastes and lifestyle. Mealime is a better way to shop - Our recipes become a grocery list that you can even have delivered – Meal kit convenience at grocery store prices!


Sign up to Mealime and join over 5,000,000 people who have used our meal plans to eat healthier, reduce stress, lose weight, save money, and live happier, more productive lives.

Check out our top 5 benefits and features:

1. The easiest way to shop for groceries
When you choose recipes for the week, all of the ingredient you’ll need are combined into a convenient grocery list. Take the app to the store and check off items as you shop, OR, to save even more time, send the list to one of our grocery fulfillment partners and buy your groceries online in less than 10 minutes at zero markup.

2. Cook healthy meals in about 30 minutes or less (even if you don't know how to cook)
We've reimagined and streamlined the cooking experience. Prepare meals quickly with our step-by-step and hassle-free cooking instructions.

You'll never again have to jump around looking for an ingredient, instruction, or piece of cookware that you may have overlooked.

3. No more stressful "What should I eat?" decisions to make
Each week you'll have a personalized meal plan with simple & healthy recipes that are catered to your exact needs and preferences.

Eliminate decision fatigue after a long day's work - simply pick a recipe from your meal plan and cook it in less time than it takes to pick up an unhealthy (and expensive) takeout meal.

4. Healthy meal plans that are uniquely your own
With the most personalization options of any minimal-waste meal planner out there, you can cook exactly how you want to eat.
From classic, flexitarian, pescetarian, low carb, paleo, keto, vegetarian & vegan diet types to gluten-free, shellfish free, fish free, dairy free, peanut free, tree nut free, soy free, egg free, sesame free, and mustard free allergy restrictions to 119 individual dislikable ingredients, your meal plans will be truly personalized to your specific needs.

5. Save money with minimal food waste
It's annoying when you purchase ingredients from the grocery store, cook a meal or two, and have a bunch of ingredients going bad by the end of the week, isn't it?

With Mealime, your days of wasting food are over! All meal plans are intelligently created in order to eliminate food waste as much as possible. You'll use up the majority of purchased ingredients if you cook your meal plan each week, saving you hundreds - if not thousands - of dollars per year.

Optional Mealime Pro subscription
Mealime is free to download and use. Should you choose to upgrade to Mealime Meal Planner Pro, we offer an auto-renewing subscription option at a price of $2.99 USD / month.

Mealime Pro includes the following additional features:

• Exclusive Pro-only recipes added every week
• View nutritional information (calories, macros, micros)
• Calorie customization filters
• Add notes to recipes
• View your previous meal plan
• World class email support

We are committed to making Mealime the best meal planning app out there. If you have any feedback or suggestions, please don't hesitate to reach out to our support email address below.

name: Meal Planner & Grocery List
developer: JoJo Apps: Meal Planner and Shopping List
description:
Meal Planner & Grocery List by Jojo Apps is the ultimate all-in-one menu organizer, smart meal generator, and recipe keeper. Designed for busy couples and families, this app helps you save time, cut grocery bills, and eat healthier by creating custom meal plans based on your specific diet, allergies, and the ingredients already in your kitchen.

WHAT IT DOES & WHO IT IS FOR


Designed for ultimate flexibility, our app adapts to your exact lifestyle. Whether you need an app to generate a personalized weekly plan for your family's specific dietary needs, digitize your grandma's old handwritten recipes, or simply share a real-time grocery list with your partner, this app completely eliminates the daily stress of figuring out what to cook.

THE PROBLEMS WE SOLVE


• Save Time: Never stand in front of the fridge wondering what to cook again. By letting the smart generator build your menu based on what is already in your kitchen, you bypass the meal planning phase entirely and stop wandering aimlessly in grocery store aisles.
• Save Money: By having the app generate a strict shopping list based on your required recipes and current pantry inventory, you avoid expensive impulse buys, confidently buy in bulk, and significantly cut down your grocery bills.
• Avoid Food Waste: Because the app tracks your pantry and builds meals around the ingredients you already have, you will use up perishables before they go bad and only buy exactly what you need.
• Improve Your Health: By using the app to visually track your weekly menus and generate meals tailored to specific diets like Keto, Mediterranean, or Vegan, you are naturally guided toward better diet variety and healthier choices.
• Reduce Stress: With automated shopping lists that sync to your partner's phone in real-time, you no longer have to stress about forgetting ingredients or miscommunicating about who is doing the grocery run.

SMART MEAL PLAN GENERATOR


• Tailored to You: Automatically generate meal plans based on your specific dietary needs, allergies, dislikes, and the exact number of people you are cooking for.
• Fridge & Pantry Integration: Tell the app what ingredients you already have at home, and it will generate recipes to use them up.
• Supported Diets: Fully supports Vegetarian, Vegan, Pesco-pollo, Pescetarian, Keto, Mediterranean, 5:2, Intermittent Fasting, Paleo, Atkins, Whole30, FODMAP, and Low-Carb lifestyles.

ADVANCED RECIPE MODULE


• Digitize Anything: Seamlessly import recipes by pasting a website URL, snapping a photo of your food, or taking a picture of an old handwritten grandma recipe card. The app extracts the details for you.
• Digital Cookbook: Maintain and organize all your favorite recipes in one centralized place.
• Direct Planning: Add meals and generate shopping lists straight from your saved recipes.

FLEXIBLE CALENDARS & REAL-TIME SYNCING


• Customizable Layouts: Plan days, weeks, or months in advance. Configure the exact number of meals you need per day.
• Partner Sync: Share your meal plan and shopping list instantly with your family so everyone is always on the same page.
• Drag-and-Drop: Easily swap meals when your schedule changes.
• Printable Menus: Generate overviews of your meal plan.
• Practical Widgets: No need to open the app to view your meal plan or grocery list.

AUTOMATED SHOPPING LISTS


• Auto-Generated Lists: The app builds your grocery list automatically based on the ingredients required for your planned meals.
• Barcode Scanner: Quickly scan and add packaged foods and household items to your lists or pantry.
• Instant Delivery: Go from zero planning to groceries at your door in seconds. Because the meal plan and grocery lists are fully auto-generated, you can instantly push your exact ingredient list directly to Instacart or Amazon Fresh for fast delivery.

name: Recipe Calculator
description:
The Kitchen Calculator app by MyKitchenCalculator.com is a tool that includes a recipe converter (recipe multiplier), cooking references, and several conversion calculators that help you easily convert between the most common measuring units used in cooking and baking.

The recipe converter tool allows you to scale, multiply, divide, or portion your recipes to the serving size you desire. Easily convert recipes to your desired serving size by typing in (*or copying and pasting*) the ingredients from your favorite online food blogs or recipe sites.

*Note: Due to the nature of text formatting, the copy and paste function may not work directly for some websites and certain mobile browsers.

The ingredient unit converter tool allows you to convert by ingredient between volume and weight units, such as cups and grams. Choose from more than 250 of the most common ingredients, such as butter, eggs, flour, and sugar!

The tool also includes basic conversion calculators for Volume, Weight, Length, Energy, Time, and Temperature. For most conversions, you can directly type in fractions as an input value, such as "1 1/2" or "3/4". The tool also keeps a history of your past conversions.

In addition to conversion calculators, the app has a Gas Mark reference and a cooking temperature references that allows you to quickly look up information about cooking temperatures for meat, candy, and other dishes.

Take the power of recipe conversion with you by downloading this app. MyKitchenCalculator.com, recipe conversion made easier!

Recipe Converter:
Multiply, divide, or portion recipes with ease. This tool will take fraction inputs and output them to the nearest fraction also!

Ingredient Unit Converter:
Convert by ingredient between common volume and weight units for more than 250 ingredients! Includes sticks of butter conversion and conversion of medium, large, and x-large whole eggs!

Volume Converter:
Convert between units of teaspoons, tablespoons, cups, pints, quarts, gallons, fluid ounces, milliliters, liters. You can also convert between US and UK (imperial) units. There is also a conversion to "Cups and Spoons". This conversion will convert volume units to denominations of common measuring cups and spoons. For example, 1.75 cups = 1 cup + 3/4 cup.

Weight Converter:
Convert between units of grams, kilograms, ounces, and pounds. You can even convert to "Pounds and Ounces".

Length Converter:
Convert between units of millimeters, centimeters, meters, kilometers, inches, feet, yards and miles. You can even convert to "Feet and Inches".

Energy Converter:
Convert between Joules, Kilojoules, Gram Calories, and Food Calories (Kilocalories)

Time Converter:
Convert between seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, and years.

Temperature Converter:
Convert between units of Fahrenheit, Celsius, and Kelvin.

Gas Mark Reference:
View common gas mark settings in Fahrenheit or Celsius.

Cooking Temperatures:
Easily look up the USDA recommended cooking temperatures of most dishes such as meats, eggs, and casseroles. You can also look up candy cooking temperatures that tell you the stages of sugar at each temperature range.

Easily share your conversions with others if your device has compatible share action apps such as certain email or text messaging apps.

Notes:
1)Conversions are calculated approximations and may not be exact.
2)US volume conversions are NIST based rounded values.
3)Conversions by ingredients are based on USDA values and actual measured values.
4)Always check for proper conversions before using converted recipes.
5)This tool is based on rounded and simplified values and is not recommended for mathematical, engineering, or scientific calculations that need precision.

SuperCook to the rescue!

Unlike other recipe apps, SuperCook only shows you recipes that require the ingredients you already have.

All the recipes you see on SuperCook are recipes you can make right now. No more inconvenient grocery runs for a missing ingredient, at a time when you should be home, with your family and friends

Why purchase new ingredients when you can focus on what you already have?

Here’s how it works:
• For Supercook to do its magic, it needs to know all the ingredients you have at home.
• Visit the pantry page in the SuperCook app and choose from a list of 2000+ ingredients broken down into categories like fruits, vegetables, meats, and many more.
• Start adding ALL the ingredients you have at home to your SuperCook pantry – including oils, spices, and yes - even that old bottle of Worcestershire sauce in the back of the fridge!
• Sit back and watch SuperCook work its magic by finding recipes that match your ingredients.

SuperCook’s Unique App Features:

--Customized Recipe Ideas--
We’ve consolidated over 11 million recipes from 18,000 recipe websites, in 20 languages to create the largest recipe collection ever. This knowledge was fed into an AI system that learnt the intricacies of all ingredients and how they can be mixed together.

All you have to do is build your pantry on the app – and you’re ready to make delicious meals without ever leaving your house!

SuperCook will find you any recipe you need, whether it’s for breakfast, lunch, dinner, or even a midnight snack.

--Easily Add Your Ingredients--
Save time and money with an intelligent pantry. SuperCook’s voice dictation mode allows you to quickly add ingredients to your in-app pantry by simply saying them out loud.

Just open your fridge, click the microphone button, and start listing everything inside. The app will automatically add the ingredients to your pantry for a quick and easy way to find recipes!

--Automatic Recipe Recommendations--
The app will automatically find you recipes to make with what’s in your fridge – so all those lost ingredients in the back of your cupboard now have a place on your table. It’s that simple!

When you run out of an ingredient, simply open the SuperCook app and remove it from your pantry - and all the recipe ideas will adjust accordingly.

--Get Creative in the Kitchen--
SuperCook inspires new ideas and activities in the kitchen for new cooks, busy parents, foodies, and pro chefs alike.

With over 11 million recipes available in 20 different languages, SuperCook promises that you’ll never cook the same thing twice (unless you want to, of course!).

--What's on the menu ?--
The menu page is where you'll find all your recipe ideas. Why is it called menu? Because just like the menu in a restaurant, everything on the menu page is available to you now. SuperCook instantly analyzes 11 million recipes and finds the ones that match your unique ingredients.

Most likely your menu page will contain thousands of recipes, but don't worry, we've broken them down into helpful categories like soups and stews, appetizers and snacks, salads, entrees, desserts and more.

--Reduce food waste--
Most people don't realize how much food they throw away every day — from uneaten leftovers to spoiled produce. SuperCook is one of the best ways to reduce food waste in the home. It finds recipes that use as many of your ingredients as possible, so nothing goes to waste. SuperCook makes food waste prevention fun and easy, just open the menu page on the app and choose a recipe. We help you use what you have, so nothing goes to waste!

Get the Results You Want

name: Prompted Journal - Shadow Work
description:
Prompted is a guided journal: a private diary that asks you a question every day, so the writing starts before the blank page can stop you.

It is built for reflection, introspection and personal growth through carefully crafted daily prompts — not just recording how you feel, but giving the feeling somewhere to go. Wellness living, manifestation and shadow work all start from the same place: a question you would not have asked yourself.

WHAT'S INSIDE

- 190+ guided journal prompts for reflection, introspection and shadow work.
- A five minute habit: one daily question, one honest answer.
- "Dive Deeper" follow-up questions on every prompt, for the days you want to keep going.
- Write your own prompts and keep them alongside the catalog.
- A private diary with a biometric lock. Your writing stays yours.
- Daily reminders that keep the habit going.
- A free quote of the day to open each entry.
- Use it as a gratitude journal, a mood diary, a dream diary or a guided journal — whatever your daily writing practice needs.

WHY A GUIDED JOURNAL

A blank page is the hardest part of keeping a diary. A guided journal with writing prompts gives every entry a starting point, so reflection happens even on the days when you have nothing to say. Dedicate five minutes and the practice becomes a routine that supports personal growth, so you can focus on what matters: understanding your inner self.

SHADOW WORK AND INTROSPECTION

Shadow work is the part of journaling that asks about the things you normally steer around. Prompted approaches it the same way it approaches everything else — with a question rather than a blank page. Use the introspective prompts to explore the parts of yourself you tend not to write about, and pair them with mood check-ins and gratitude entries so the practice stays balanced. A shadow work journal only works if you actually open it, which is what the daily question is for.

FOR PEOPLE WHO HAVE BOUNCED OFF JOURNALING

If you have downloaded a journal app before, written twice and stopped, the problem was probably never discipline — it was the empty screen. A daily question removes the hardest decision. Answer it, close the app, come back tomorrow. That is the whole loop, and it is why a guided diary survives ordinary weeks when a blank one does not.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Entries live behind a biometric lock, and your diary stores its entries in local app storage on your device. No account is required: there is no sign-up and no email address to hand over.

YOUR ENTRIES, YOUR COPY

Export a PDF or a CSV through your device's share controls. PDF export is quota-limited on the free tier; premium removes the limit.

FREE AND PREMIUM

Prompted is free to download and the daily practice is free to use. Premium opens the rest of the prompt catalog and lifts the export quota. Price, billing period, renewal terms and any free trial are shown in the app and on this store listing, in your local currency.

A DAILY WRITING PRACTICE

Some people keep Prompted as a self care diary, some as a shadow work journal, some as a reflection app, some as a plain daily record with a question attached. The prompt is the point: it makes the practice repeatable on the ordinary days, which are most of them.

Download Prompted and start today — a private diary with guided prompts for reflection, shadow work and growth.

name: Three Good Things - Gratitude
description:
Three Good Things is a simple gratitude journal for the end of the day — a private daily diary for positivity, mood and calm.

Every evening, write down three good things that happened and how each one made you feel. That is the whole practice. Write them, then put the phone down.

Inspired by the Three Good Things exercise studied in positive psychology.

WHAT THE APP DOES

- Three good things a day. Short entries, not essays.
- The "I felt" prompt. After each good thing, note the feeling that came with it.
- Memories. Re-read past entries and watch your good days collect over months and years.
- A daily reminder at a time you choose.
- A quote each day.
- Themes, including a night mode for reading in bed.
- Works as a mood diary too: the feelings you note build a quiet record of your moods over the months.

PRIVACY

- No account is required. There is no sign-up, and no email address to hand over.
- Journal entries are stored locally in app storage. Exporting or sharing creates a copy through your device's share controls.
- No ads. No AI.

YOUR ENTRIES, YOUR COPY

Export a CSV that can be imported later, or a PDF readable archive. Premium includes unlimited exports; the free app includes three.

FREE AND PREMIUM

The daily practice is free. Premium adds decorative themes and a polished PDF keepsake. Price, billing period, renewal terms and any free trial are shown in the app and on this store listing, in your local currency.

A DAILY GRATITUDE HABIT

Three short entries make a five minute gratitude practice. Done nightly, the gratitude journal becomes a daily habit of noticing — a small act of self care before bed. Some people keep it alongside a longer diary or a mood tracker; this journal only ever asks for the good things, so being grateful stays easy.

ABOUT THE PRACTICE

The three good things exercise asks you to name three things that went well and your part in them. It has been studied in positive psychology, and it is deliberately small: the point is that it is easy enough to do on an ordinary evening.

WHO IT IS FOR

People who have started a journal before and stopped. If a blank page has ever felt like homework, this daily diary asks for a good deal less: three good things, a feeling for each, done.

Download Three Good Things and start your gratitude journal tonight — a simple daily journaling practice for a more grateful evening.

name: Moodi: emotions & mood tracker
description:
Moodi is a self-help therapy journal with effective psychological exercises and emotion tracker to strengthen your mental health and overcome anxiety & depression, stress, low self-esteem, or other psychological difficulties. Take advantage of this CBT mood diary therapy and help yourself to raise your mood, increase awareness, and enjoy its anti-stress effect.


A psychological diary is a highly effective self-help practice


Psychologists recommend keeping a psychological diary. It can be an emotion tracker, a mood diary a CBT journal, or free-form entries.


As the best self-help practice, it will help you:


  • Better understand yourself, your thoughts, feelings, reactions, and relationships with other people

  • Express emotions and experiences, rather than suppressing them, and ensure better emotional regulation and stress reduction

  • Approach problem-solving and decision-making mindfully

  • Identify sources of stress and anxiety and find ways to cope with them

  • Improve personal development and growth

Self-help practices you will find in this mental health therapy app


Negative situations diary


A Negative Situations Diary is a very effective self-help technique for solving psychological problems. It will help you cope with painful and anxious moments more easily, understand how some events affect your feelings and mood, and strategize your reactions for similar situations in the future.


Make entries about every negative moment, track your thoughts, mark emotions, and select a cognitive distortion. With this therapy journal, you can better understand yourself, your behavior, and your feelings associated with a specific event. Help yourself to free your mind from negativity, and feel much better. By changing your approach to resolving negative situations, your reaction to them will also change.


Positive moments diary


In the Positive Moments Diary (Gratitude Journal), you can write down all your positive events, good emotions, and gratitude. It helps you pay attention to the pleasant moments and, thus, reduce stress and other negative feelings.


Everything that causes positive emotions truly matters. So, use these positive emotions for self-help mindfully. Whether you had a significant event or something fleeting, write it down and mark the emotions you experienced. And motivate yourself.


Morning diary


With the Morning Diary, you can help yourself set up for the day ahead and free your mind from needless worries, irrational anxieties, and negativity. By practicing this morning diary and mood tracker, you will notice how your energy, motivation, awareness, and creativity rise.


Write down your emotions, feelings, experiences, plans, tasks, goals, and desires every day, immediately after you wake up. Write down everything that seems important to you at that moment.


Evening diary


An Evening Diary is an effective self-help practice. With it, you can track your emotions, feelings, and thoughts at the end of the day, right before going to bed. With this mental health tracker, you can analyze your day and get rid of unfounded worries, stress and tension, anxiety & depression. All this helps you relax, sleep better, and recover.


Write down your events and impressions of the past day. Describe your emotions, feelings, self-esteem, and physical condition in detail. Write down the lesson you learn from this day. Don't try to write it correctly, just be honest and record things you believe to be important for you at that moment.


Download Moodi, a CBT therapy journal and mental health tracker. Put one of the most effective self-help practices on your service. Trace and analyze your negative situations and positive moments, and keep a morning journal and evening mood diary. Learn to save and cherish positive feelings and get rid of anxiety & depression.

name: Dosecast - Pill Reminder App
description:
Established in 2010, thousands continue to use Dosecast - Pill Reminder & Medication Tracker App, the most easy Medication reminder app to help manage ones & their loved one's medications, vitamins, or birth control pills on time -- with unique live sync between devices!

Dosecast - Pill Reminder & Medication Tracker App has been featured in the New York Times, Real Simple magazine, Reader's Digest, About.com, Fierce Mobile Healthcare, and iMedicalApps.com. Remember to take the right drug, the right way & time with this Pill Reminder.

💊 Dosecast Free edition:

🔔 RELIABLE NOTIFICATIONS: Dosecast reliably sends dose reminders to your phone, tablet or Android Wear device and lets you postpone them, like a snooze button. If you miss the first reminder, It can nag you until you respond. It can also sound a continuous alarm. Dosecast Pill Reminder updates your reminder times as you travel across time zones.

⏰ FLEXIBLE SCHEDULING: Some apps can only remind you to take your medication at a fix time daily. Only Pill Tracker helps you take doses on a daily/weekly/monthly schedule, every X days/weeks, only on certain days of the week, or even after a pre-set number of hours or days since the last dose. Avoid dangerous overdoses by setting a maximum number of doses allowed per day.

📝 CUSTOMIZABLE DOSE AMOUNTS AND INSTRUCTIONS: Set the drug name, dosage information, directions, and notes that appear in the reminders for each dose. You can also track each drug's expiration date.

⏱️ POSTPONE MEDICATION REMINDER: You can postpone a pill reminder before or after it goes off.

🔇 SMART SILENCING: Dosecast tracks when you're sleeping or your treatment begins & ends.

🔒 PRIVATE AND SECURE: No personal information is collected when using Pill Reminder. All drug information is encrypted when in transit, so using it's safe even in a public area.


Features of Pro edition with Cloud Sync:

📱 MULTI-DEVICE SYNC: The Dosecast - Pill Tracker & Medication Reminder Cloud Sync service keeps your data up-to-date across an unlimited number of Apple and Android devices.

💉 MULTIPLE DRUG TYPES: You can track drugs taken via injections, inhalers, drops, sprays, ointments, patches, liquid doses, and more.

💊 DOSE HISTORY AND COMPLIANCE: Dosecast - Pill Reminder & Medication Tracker logs the date & time of doses you take, skip, or postpone so you can view or email the history at any time. It even logs late & missed doses so you can accurately track your drug compliance. If you forget to log a dose when you take it, you can edit the history later.

💯 QUANTITY TRACKING AND REFILL ALERTS: Dosecast tracks the remaining quantity of each drug you enter and delivers a refill alert when running low. It will even track the number of refills remaining and alert you when you have no refills left!

👨‍👩‍👧 MULTI-PERSON SUPPORT: Assign specific medication reminder to different people (or even pets). Sort your medications by person, time of next dose, drug name, or drug type - so you can keep your whole family's medication schedule organized.

👨‍⚕️ DOCTOR AND PHARMACY TRACKING: Use your contacts to track which doctor is prescribing which drug, as well as track the pharmacy and prescription number for each.

🗃️ DRUG DATABASE: Entering drug information is easy! Simply pick your medication from our drug database to pre-populate the drug name, type, amount, strength, and route.

🖼️ CUSTOM DRUG PHOTOS: Take your own photos of each drug to identify it more easily. With drug photos, you can be sure you're taking the right drug when a dose is due.

The Pro Edition comes with a 7-day free trial. It can be cancelled at any time.
Confidently take the right drug, the right way, at the right time, every time with Dosecast - Pill Reminder & Medication Tracker App!

Loud, silent, or vibration-only pill tracker notifications

Persistent medicine reminder banners until you confirm

Missed a pill last Tuesday? Scroll the timeline and see every confirmation, skip, or snooze. Export beautifully formatted PDF or CSV reports straight to your doctor. Keeping track of bottles is as important as taking the dose. Pill Reminder subtracts each confirmed pill, warns you when only three days remain, and creates a pharmacy shopping list you can share. Your Medicine Tracker automatically calculates refill-by dates and even spots insurance-eligible mail-order opportunities.

🧑‍⚕️ Designed For Every Situation
Seniors needing a large-text med reminder

Parents juggling children's cough syrups and allergy drops

Athletes monitoring supplements and electrolytes

Chronic conditions like diabetes, hypertension, HIV, epilepsy, ADHD, transplant follow-ups
Wherever life takes you, Pill Reminder and its companion Medicine Tracker module travel too.

• Dark Mode & Dynamic Type for tired eyes

• Multiple profiles keep family members separate without extra subscriptions

🔐 Total Control & Privacy
We're independent—no big-pharma backing, no ad networks. All analytics are anonymous and optional. Because trust is medicine too, Pill Reminder lets you back up, restore, or delete everything with one tap.

💳 Plans & Pricing
Download free and explore the complete feature set for 7 days. Love it? Keep healthy habits running with:
• Weekly – $0.99 (flexible, cancel anytime)
• Yearly – $19.99 (save 60 % and get priority support)
Both plans unlock unlimited medications, family profiles, PDF exports, premium themes, and future Medicine Tracker upgrades. If you change your mind, just cancel in Settings; your Pill Reminder stays fully functional until the period ends.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions
Q: What happens if I switch phones?
A: Sign in with the same Apple ID and the Medicine Tracker sync engine restores every schedule.

A: Yes—mark them as "Take when required," and Pill Reminder logs the exact time and dose.

A: Unlimited. You can run 30 prescriptions, 50 vitamins, or a single daily tablet—the Pill Reminder core handles it effortlessly.

description:

Taking drugs always involves risks - however, if you do decide to take drugs, KnowDrugs can help you to take appropriate measures to reduce potential harms.

DRUG INFORMATION & EDUCATION

Check the profiles of more than 200 drugs for educational purposes: Stimulants like MDMA and Amphetamine, depressants such as Alcohol and Benzodiazepines or psychedelics like 2C-B, LSD and DMT.

KnowDrugs provides you with drug education harm reduction advice, focusing on MDMA / Molly / Ecstasy and other psychoactive substances. Knowing about the wanted and unwanted effects of drugs, their duration, interactions and risks helps you to make more informed decisions, reduce risks and reflect upon your drug habits and consumption behaviour.

DRUG CHECKING, PILL WARNINGS & DRUG ALERTS

Search for drug name, substance or location, to find drug alerts from nearby and learn about their ingredients and dosage strength to avoid overdose and particularly dangerous cuts (e.g. PMA).

Drug checking or pill testing is a way to reduce the harm from drug consumption by allowing users to find out the content and purity of substances that they intend to consume. This empowers users to make safer choices: to avoid more dangerous substances and combination and to use smaller quantities.

If you don't have access to professional drug testing services, looking up recent drug testing results can still help you make a more informed decision about your consumption.

HARM REDUCTION & RESPONSIBLE DRUG USE

Harm reduction aims to minimize the harms associated with recreational substance use. The harm reduction approach follows from the idea that substance use is a high-risk activity that innately entails the possibility of injury, addiction, and death. Therefore, the best strategy one can employ (outside of avoiding use entirely) is to take appropriate measures to mitigate its potential harms.

KnowDrugs highlights the harm-potential of more than 200 substances and demonstrates strategies on how to reduce the harms associated with the consumption of drugs.

KNOWDRUGS CAN ALSO HELP YOU TO:

- learn how to spot and react in case of an emergency, take care of someone experiencing a bad trip at a party or festival
- find a free and confidential counselling service which accepts you and your personal choices, and helps you develop the right strategies and competencies if you want to change something about your consumption behaviour.

description:
Description:
Healthcare professionals and patients should use this application to search for potential drug-drug interactions between hepatitis drugs and other medications, as recommended by international treatment guidelines. Results are presented as a “Traffic Light” system (red, amber, yellow, green) to indicate the recommendation. A brief summary of each interaction is given. The application is available free of charge and has been developed by the Liverpool Drug Interactions Group at the University of Liverpool and Clubzap Ltd.

Requirements:
This is an “offline” application that is downloaded to your device. An internet connection is not required to use the application, but is needed for downloading updates.

Why this application may be useful:
In hepatitis therapy, patients take more than one hepatitis medication at a time and possibly other drugs to treat co-existing conditions. Many of the drug combinations have the potential to interact and this can affect either the patient's safety or the effectiveness of treatment. For this reason some drug combinations should not be given at all, while other drugs may be used together with caution, possibly requiring adjustments to dosage or time of administration. This application is a guide to interactions that may occur between different hepatitis drugs and other medications that the HCV- and/or HBV-infected patient may be prescribed. The application is regularly updated as new data emerge. Full details about the interactions can be found at www.hep-druginteractions.org.

name: Allday HVAC Calc
description:
The application can be useful for HVAC engineers and contains 3 modules.

Psychrometric Calculator - this module determines air properties based on input values such as dry-bulb temperature, wet-bulb temperature, and relative humidity. It provides results like humidity ratio, specific volume, enthalpy, and vapor pressure in both SI and IP units.

Pipe Calculator - this module is used to calculate velocity and pressure loss in pipelines and to select pipeline diameters for a given maximum velocity and pressure loss. The module supports interdependent calculations of flow rate, heat load, and fluid temperatures: when any three of these parameters are specified, the fourth is calculated automatically. It can also be used as a reference for heat transfer fluid properties and pipe characteristics.

Duct Calculator - the module is used to calculate the speed and pressure loss in round, rectangular and oval air ducts when moving wet or dry air through them, as well as to select their sections for a given maximum speed and maximum pressure loss. Additionally, the heating or cooling power is calculated for a given air flow rate, or reverse calculations: air flow rate for a given power; temperature of incoming or outgoing air for a given power and flow rate. It can also be used as a reference material for determining the properties of wet and dry air at different pressures and temperatures.

Also in the description sections are the reference formulas by which the calculations are made.
