CALCULATION METHODS:
Temperature Delta Method — CFM from BTU load and supply/return temperature difference
Duct Velocity Method — CFM from duct size (round or rectangular) and air velocity (FPM)
Sensible Heat Method — CFM from sensible cooling/heating capacity and temperature delta
Total Heat Method — CFM from total heat load and enthalpy difference

name: Superheat Calculator - HVAC
description:
HVAC Superheat & Subcool Calculator is the professional field diagnostic tool for AC service and system commissioning. Calculate superheat, subcooling, and saturation for 10 refrigerants including R-410A, R-454B (EPA 608 transition), and R-32 with smart charge diagnostics and color-coded results for instant field diagnostics.

FEATURES:
Instant Superheat & Subcooling Calculation — Get results in seconds
Smart Charge Diagnostics — Normal, Low, or High with recommendations
10 Refrigerants Supported — R-410A, R-22, R-454B, R-32, R-407C, R-134a, R-404A, R-507A, R-290, R-717
Metering Device Support — TXV (expansion valve) or fixed orifice
Color-Coded Results — Green/yellow/red for quick decisions
P-T Saturation Data — NIST REFPROP-grade, verified against manufacturer charts
Zeotropic Blend Support — Correct bubble/dew handling for blends

100% OFFLINE:
All refrigerant data built-in. Works on job sites without cellular coverage.

HOW IT WORKS:
1. Select refrigerant (R-410A, R-454B, R-32, etc.)
2. Select metering device (TXV or fixed orifice)
3. Enter suction pressure & temperature
4. Enter liquid pressure & temperature
5. Get instant superheat, subcooling & charge diagnosis

UNDERSTANDING RESULTS:
Superheat — Temperature rise above saturation on low side. Normal 10-20°F TXV, 15-25°F fixed orifice. Low indicates overcharge; high indicates undercharge or low airflow.

Subcooling — Temperature drop below saturation on high side. Normal 10-20°F. Low indicates undercharge; high indicates overcharge.

DIAGNOSTICS:
Green — Normal charge, optimal operation
Yellow — Borderline condition requiring attention

name: Pomodoro Timer
description:
Bring structure to your workflow by utilising time blocking technique.


Time blocking is an effective strategy for using time wisely and achieving greater results. Blocking out time for specific activities allows you to focus on one task at a time, limit distractions and procrastination.


It's really simple to use:


1. Define your tasks at hand, make a task list.

2. Define a block of time during which you will eliminate all distractions and give all your focus to your tasks. Start the timer and work.

3. Take frequent breaks. Regular breaks are conducive to greater productivity and concentration. During these breaks take a breath of fresh air, do some push-ups, stretch or anything else that helps you to restore your power. Your body will thank you.

4. Repeat this work/break cycle and take a longer breaks when you feel you need to.

We're not another list, calendar, or app: we're REAL human interactions paired with expert strategies and experimentation, so that you can make real changes in your life. Oh, and we also have ADHD too!

2. have concrete executive function skills they’d like to improve on and are looking for guidance to follow through: we provide the critical knowledge, resources, guidance, support, and accountability so that you actually implement the changes (routines, skills, tools) that will help you reach your goals
3. know they can achieve more and aren’t living at their potential: we use an ACT-based methodology to help you identify your values and help you live in line with them

Our ADHD coaches partner with you to co-design a plan to achieve your goals. You'll experiment with strategies on a weekly basis to implement a routine fit specifically for YOU. Our program has been designed off science-backed methods in partnership with NYU, UC Berkeley, and UCSF.

- Attend weekly 1:1 check-ins with your coach
- Personalized plan each week catered to you
- Experiment with tailored skills, strategies, and routines
- Text-based accountability check-ins throughout the week from your coach
- Learn ADHD skills and tips through bite-sized learning modules

The biggest value we’ve heard from our members are:

- An expert ADHD coach that knows ADHD inside out and understands them
- An accountability partner to hold them to what they said they’d do
- Someone to help them break down big tasks to feel less overwhelmed
- Guidance to navigate the sea of content and resources out there
- Personalized positive reinforcement, support and celebration of the little things
- Weekly cadence to make baby steps for changes in their life
- An affordable alternative to traditional ADHD coaching that fits into their life

Our coaches are specialized in taking an ADHD-adapted approach to coaching and are skilled at helping you navigate life’s ups and downs. Not sure if you’re in the right place? Our members come to use and are working on:

- Understanding their ADHD
- Feeling they’re not living up to their full potential
- Goal setting & habit building
- Creating routines & schedules
- Feelings of overwhelm, paralysis, and inability to turn brain off

name: Social Battery: Vibe Check
description:
﻿How charged are you today? 🔋

Some days you're a fully charged social butterfly. Other days you're at 4% and one "hey, quick question" away from total shutdown.

Social Battery helps you show your friends exactly where your social energy is at — with a little humor along the way.

What you can do:

🔋 Set your charge

😂 Get your vibe
Pair your battery level with relatable, funny status messages like "I can handle a meeting, but I'll need a nap after."

👯 Share with friends
Send your current vibe to a friend with a tap so they know whether today is a "let's hang" or "text me tomorrow" kind of day.

👥 Create groups
Set up groups like Close Friends, Work, or Family and share your energy level with the right people in one tap.

🏷️ Add custom nicknames
Give friends private nicknames that only you can see — keep your feed personal.

🔕 Silence any friend
Mute notifications from specific friends without them knowing. Your space, your rules.

🔗 Connect easily
Swap 6-digit invite codes. No phone numbers, no email, and no contact-list permissions required.

📊 Track your history
See your own battery trends over time with a personal energy chart.

📲 Share anywhere
Export your battery status as an image and drop it into any chat, story, or group.

📅 Set a named event
Let friends know what you're up to — name the event (like "date night" or "work meeting") and set a countdown so they can see when you'll be free again.

😄 React from your notifications
When a friend shares an update, react with an emoji right from the notification — no need to open the app.

💎 Free with Premium option
Use Social Battery free with up to 3 friends. Upgrade to Premium once — no subscription — for unlimited friends.

🤝 Works with any phone
Your friends on iPhone or Android can all join in — no one's left out.

Why you'll love it:

Social Battery is the mood tracker and social check-in app for introverts, extroverts, and anyone managing social anxiety or burnout — turn "I don't have the energy today" into something you can actually show, and laugh about. It's a fun, honest way to let people know how social you're feeling without overexplaining.

Stop overexplaining. Start sharing your charge. 🔋

name: Battery Analyzer
description:
⚡ Battery Analyzer is a real-time battery monitor and charging monitor for device-reported battery current, charging sessions, temperature, level, and voltage.

See how the net current entering or leaving your battery changes while charging or discharging. Follow live battery statistics, explore charging charts, and review locally recorded charging history in one place.

IMPORTANT: Current values are device-reported net battery current in milliamps (mA), not a measurement of the charger's direct output. Reading availability, update frequency, and accuracy depend on the device, Android version, and manufacturer.

📈 LIVE BATTERY CURRENT MONITOR
• Monitor device-reported charge and discharge current in mA
• Readings update approximately once per second when available
• See minimum and maximum recorded current for the active session
• View a live charging chart over 60 seconds, 10, 60, or 120 minutes
• Choose a smooth trend line or collected current samples
• Check battery level, voltage, and battery temperature
• See the Android-reported plug type: AC, USB, Wireless, or Dock
• Follow the session timer from plug-in or unplug
• Enable an ongoing notification with current, level change, and elapsed time

🔬 CHARGING PROFILE BY BATTERY LEVEL
Analyze recorded charging behavior across ten battery-level ranges: 0-10%, 10-20%, and onward through 90-100%. Each range shows its average device-reported battery-current reading.
• See the highest range average and the average for the 50-60% range
• Observe how recorded charging current changes as the battery fills
• Compare recorded behavior from different chargers or cables range by range
• Build long-term averages from retained charging sessions
• Review duration, average readings, highest range average, and sample count for each session

📜 CHARGING AND DISCHARGING HISTORY
• Keep up to the 199 most recent charging and discharging sessions
• Review start and end battery level, duration, and recorded current range
• Use the level track to see where each battery session began and ended
• Follow an in-progress session while battery monitoring is active

🔋 BATTERY INFORMATION
Battery Analyzer displays values reported or exposed by Android and the device. Depending on device support, additional information may include battery technology, Android-reported battery condition, and available RAM. Unsupported values are hidden rather than estimated.

⚙️ PERSONALIZE YOUR BATTERY MONITOR
• Dark, light, or system theme
• Teal or blue accent color
• Celsius (°C) or Fahrenheit (°F)
• 18 languages, including right-to-left Arabic
• Core battery monitoring works offline
• Monitoring can resume after reboot when enabled, although Android or device settings may restrict background operation

⭐ PRO — one-time purchase, yours forever
• Removes all ads

No subscription, ever.

🔒 PRIVACY
Recorded battery measurements and session history stay locally on your device and are not uploaded to our servers. No account, location permission, or storage permission is required. Google services are used for ads, analytics, and crash reporting as described in the privacy policy.

name: Extrovert or Introvert Test
description:
This test measures the personality trait of extraversion.

Personality traits are relatively stable over time, but they can and often do gradually change as you age.

People who are more extraverted tend to feel energized by social interactions, enjoy meeting and socializing with people, and are often the center of attention. They are often perceived as outgoing, social, full of energy, enthusiastic, and action-oriented.

People who are more introverted tend to feel drained by social interactions, prefer a good amount of solitude, and dislike small talk. They are often perceived as quiet, low-key, and deliberate. They need less stimulation and more time alone than extraverts.

name: Sectograph. Day & Time planner
description:
🎯 Sectograph is a new, intuitive way to view your calendar and daily schedule.

It shows your day as a circular planner — a 12-hour clock face — with events and free time between them.
A visual time planner for time blocking, time management, and a clearer sense of time.


⚙️ HOW IT WORKS

Sectograph is lightweight, privacy-friendly, and works with your existing calendars on the device.
It overlays your day planner (routine, local calendar, Google Calendar) onto a clock-face timeline and automatically calculates:

• upcoming events
• time blocks and durations
• gaps between events and your real free time

Everything updates as time passes, keeping your schedule always current.
Not a to-do list — it’s a calendar-based schedule planner that visualizes what’s already on your calendar.


👀 HOW IT LOOKS

Like an analog clock your brain already understands — but with your day mapped onto it as sectors.

• Events appear exactly in the hours they happen (a radial / circular calendar view)
• Each sector width matches the event duration (a true pie-chart schedule)
• See gaps and the time from “now” to the next event at a glance

A clock planner / visual planner that helps you read your day instantly.


🎯 USE CASES & IDEAS

Use Sectograph as a day planner, daily planner, time planner, or routine planner for time management and daily schedule planning.
Great for time blocking (deep work, meetings, breaks), work/shift schedules, class schedules, travel itineraries, and Pomodoro planning (place focus sessions as time blocks).
If you like Chronodex, you’ll feel right at home.


🔄 SYNC & CALENDARS

Reads events from Google Calendar and your local device calendar; Microsoft Outlook calendar: beta.


📱 HOME SCREEN CALENDAR WIDGET

Keep your schedule always visible with a calendar widget / home screen widget.

• Automatic updates (including a clock refresh once a minute)
• Tap a sector to open details and quick actions
• Flexible visual settings + free widget themes: Dark / White / Gray
• Optional: light/dark app theme, 24-hour mode & extra zoom (1–12h), month/day grid views


⌚ WEAR OS (SMARTWATCH SUPPORT)

A true Wear OS calendar / smartwatch calendar at a glance:

• Watch app with an interactive widget
• Tile for quick access to the circular planner
• Watch face for continuous schedule awareness (installed separately)
• Large complication to enhance some third-party watch faces


🧠 HELPFUL FOR ADHD & “TIME BLINDNESS”

Designed to make time easier to grasp — especially if you struggle with time blindness, which is common for people with ADHD.
(Sectograph is not a medical app.)

✅ Install Sectograph and get a calm, visual overview of your day.

name: Diem: Big Group Chat Energy
description:
AI Search, Community Chats

Welcome to Diem! We’re building your new front door to the internet.

Diem is a search-engine-meets-social-network designed first for girls, women, and LGBTQIA+ folks. You can search the internet with Diem AI and find answers to anything life throws at you. “How do I get over a friend breakup? What’s the best way to negotiate salary? My boyfriend follows models on Instagram—is that a red flag?” Diem is here to help.

Our platform is also full of novel, collective knowledge from people all over the world. You can socialize your search to start conversations, discover a network of communities, connect over shared experiences and browse trending topics.

Joining Diem means showing up with no judgment and immersing yourself in the candid, funny, authentic, important, supportive, outrageous, honest, and wholesome questions of other Diemers, which span everything from birth control to friendship, sexuality to pop culture, parenting to relationships, money to reproductive health, career to books, and so much more. Diem feels more like searching for answers in the girls’ bathroom than spiraling alone on the internet.

Here’s what you can find in the app today:

Diem AI-powered search

Ask Diem AI, our AI-powered search tool, your questions! Our search engine is designed to be less bias than other models. You can think of Diem AI as your most knowledgeable Virgo “big sister” who lives in your back pocket. Diem AI draws from across the internet and the collective wisdom of Diemers to generate you a speedy answer. When you ask Diem AI you’ll receive a short summary answer, community sources (previous, related conversations in Diem), community spaces, web pages, Reddit threads and TikTok videos. You can dive in to these search results OR you can post your search to the community feed to get real-time feedback from people who’ve been there.

Diem AI Lenses

You can now ask questions of leading experts and your fave creators in Diem. Ask their Lens anything and your search result will feature their opinions & content from across the internet.

Discover thousands of authentic conversations

From awkward sex questions to wholesome big sisterly advice or navigating life’s highs and lows, Diem is full of the collective knowledge of girls, women, and LGBTQIA+ folks in over 100 countries.There’s no judgment here and you’ll feel that very quickly.

Post anonymously or under a pseudonym

We think of the anonymous feature as a confidence booster. Sometimes posting ‘taboo’ questions or personal stories publicly can be nerve-wracking, so this feature is designed to make you feel more comfortable while getting the advice you need.

Community Spaces

Community Spaces are micro communities that are also discoverable when related questions are searched via Diem AI. A few currently live: Am I wrong?, Big Sis Advice (BSA) and Is this Normal…? (ITN) We’re still early in building out Spaces and you can request additional Spaces or host your own.

Creating Posts

name: Allergy Food Alert
description:
Allergy Food Alert helps you shop with food allergies or intolerances in mind. Scan a barcode to load Open Food Facts data, or photograph an ingredient list on the pack to read the text on your device and check it against your personal allergen profile—including severity and alerts you choose.

Features
• Barcode scanning — Use the camera to load product data from Open Food Facts.
• Ingredient photos — Capture a clear photo of the ingredient list on the packaging; on-device text recognition (Google ML Kit) extracts the text, which is then checked with the same keyword logic as ingredient text from the database. Recognition works best with Latin script; other scripts may not read reliably—always verify the physical label.
• Personal allergen profile — Pick allergens to track and set severity (mild to critical), with alerts where you need them.
• Clear safety signals — See whether a product is high risk, needs caution, or shows no strong match for your profile, using declared allergens, traces, and ingredient text when available.
• Ingredients & allergen text — View declared allergens, “may contain” / traces, and ingredient lists from the database.
• On-device translation — Choose how to show ingredients: match your device language with automatic translation (Google ML Kit on device), or show the original text from Open Food Facts.
• Saved scans — Save products with custom names; open, review, or delete them later.
• Settings — Update your allergen profile and ingredient language anytime.
• Contribute — Jump to Open Food Facts to improve data (photos, structured allergens, details).

Important — Allergy Food Alert relies on open community data and on-device recognition; neither is guaranteed complete or accurate. Photo and text recognition can misread words or miss lines. It is not medical or legal advice. Manufacturers can change recipes before databases update. Always read the physical product label before you buy or eat—especially if your allergy is severe.

➜ The Nutri-Score grade, from A to E : Nutritional quality
➜ The NOVA group, from 1 to 4 : Avoid ultra-processed foods (Group 4)

➜ You can use it to make better food choices, and as it is open data, anyone can re-use it for any purpose.

➜ Open Food Facts helps you decipher products labels. You will be able to find:
➜ carbon footprint (CO2 emissions) and packaging (as well as recycling instructions),
➜ Nutriscore (nutritional score), nutrients, fat / fat content, saturated fatty acids, carbohydrates, sugars, fiber, protein and salt and sodium.
➜ brands, allergens, labels (bio, gluten free, vegan, vegetarian, halal, kosher ...), traceability information (packaging codes, origins of ingredients)
➜ On wines and beers, you will find the alcohol content.

🔬 Backed by Science, Supporting Research


➜ We don't make up things. We rely on peer-reviewed science.
➜ The Nutri-Score has been created by the independent French team led by Professor Hercberg.
➜ The NOVA groups on food processing have been designed by the international team of Professor Monteiro.
➜ The additives synthesis is based on reviews by EFSA on exposure levels on food additives.
➜ The Open Food Facts community is collaborating with research teams across the planet to improve nutrition research that benefits all.

🔒 Your food, your data. Privacy-Centric App


➜ Your data is yours, and is never sent online
➜ You can use the app anonymously
➜ You can export your scan history

➜ Speed up your shopping by doing an initial screening of your food with Open Food Facts.

- Contribute to Price Transparency. When you shop, add the price on the shelf, or at home, add the receipt. Let's track shrinkflation, cheapflation & more.

description:
EATING OUT SHOULDN'T BE THIS HARD.

If you have celiac disease or a gluten intolerance, you've probably done this before.

You find a restaurant that looks promising.

You read reviews. You search Facebook groups. You look at crowdsourced apps. You study the menu. You call the restaurant. You hope the person on the phone actually understands what you're asking.

Maybe you feel better.

Maybe you don't.

Either way, you're still left making one of the most important decisions of your day with incomplete information.

That's the part I wanted to fix.

EVERY RESTAURANT EARNS ITS PLACE.

All restaurants start with someone in the gluten-free community who had a safe experience and told us about it.

Then our team gets to work.

First, we research the restaurant — looking into their gluten-free practices and reputation before we ever reach out.

Then we vet it directly. We contact the restaurant and ask the questions that matter. How do they prevent cross-contact? Is there a dedicated fryer? Does the staff understand celiac disease?

Then we write everything up in plain English, so you know what to expect before you ever walk through the door.

Community starting points.

Independent research.

Complete transparency.

WHY I BUILT GLUTEN DUDE.

I've had celiac disease since 2007.

Like you, I've spent way too much time trying to figure out where it was actually safe to eat. I've been glutened by restaurants that sounded confident. I've asked all the awkward questions.

After years of doing the same research over and over, I had one thought:

Why isn't someone doing this for us?

So I built the app I wished I'd had.

KNOW WHAT YOU'RE LOOKING AT.

Every restaurant is clearly labeled, so there's never any guessing about what you're getting.

• 100% Gluten-Free
